discoveredIssues.description: foh-setup-backend: setup writes bypass withReservationWrite and run no transaction (floor-plan save deletes and re-inserts rsv_floor_elements non-atomically; version checks are lockless) — mission AGENTS.md write-path directive, VAL-SETUP-011/017. Hold-minute ranges not enforced (1..120 accepted vs 3..20/10..60/5..30, VAL-SETUP-005). Turn-time minutes allow 15..720 vs 15..480 with no overlap rejection (VAL-SETUP-019). Special-day CRUD does not bump rsv_day_versions (VAL-SETUP-022). Combo duplicate member sets not rejected on update and the floor-plan combo upsert is unvalidated (VAL-SETUP-010).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Route setup writes through withReservationWrite (or at least one transaction plus per-org serialization), enforce the documented hold/turn-time ranges and overlap rules, bump day versions on special-day create/update/delete, and validate combination member sets on update and floor-plan save.

discoveredIssues.description: foh-setup-ui: the floor-plan canvas clears its dirty flag after a failed save (route swallows 409/5xx, canvas calls setDirty(false) unconditionally) so the header shows 'Saved', Leave stops prompting and the draft can be silently replaced — breaks VAL-SETUP-011's explicit-Save/local-draft discipline. Hardcoded English labels in weekday chips, table/element shape options and special-day/block enum badges render English under ?lng=ar (VAL-SETUP-031, mission i18n directive).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Have the save handler signal success/failure before clearing dirty (or clear dirty only on success), and wrap the label/option tables and badges in Lingui messages, then re-extract and fill Arabic.

discoveredIssues.description: foh-book-and-host-backend: POST /internal/reservations/location-summary returns the org-wide /summary shape while the App guard requires {locationId, futureReservations}, so the location-delete guard always answers 503 (VAL-BOOK-031). GET /book/conflicts and GET /reservations/:id/events are missing (VAL-BOOK-012/013). covers/coversActual never reaches the status service so covers_actual/rsv_guests.covers store the party size (VAL-BOOK-017). contact_statuses_enabled/course_statuses_enabled are never enforced (VAL-BOOK-022). Soft reflow writes table_changed instead of auto_reassigned (VAL-HOST-008). upsertServiceNotes ignores expectedVersion and section-assignments is unversioned. The seed silently drops 5 field groups through wrong column names (sortOrder/arrivedPartySize/guestNotes/internalNotes). The contract paths /contact-status and /course-status are registered as /contact and /course.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Return the location-scoped summary shape the guard parses; add the two contract endpoints; accept covers in the status route/service; enforce the two settings with 409/400; write the canonical auto_reassigned event; compare expectedVersion for service notes and section assignments; fix the seed column names and verify seeded values with sqlite3; serve the contract paths or reconcile the docs (orchestrator decision).

discoveredIssues.description: foh-book-and-host-ui: live timers tick every 30 s instead of the required 15 s (floor.tsx:148, use-host-stand.ts:89) so a >=16 s observation can see no tick (VAL-HOST-013). The detail sheet neither pauses day polling nor protects unsaved edits — every poll replaces selectedReservation and re-runs syncFormFromReservation, resetting typed notes/party size/time/duration (VAL-BOOK-014). Hardcoded English keyboard-DnD announcements and rendered option labels (timeline, floor, detail sheet, booking sheet, section colours) fail the Arabic RTL assertions (VAL-HOST-027, VAL-BOOK-037) and the mission i18n directive.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Pass 15_000 to useLiveNow; pause the day feed while ?r=<id> is open or sync the form only when the reservation id/version changes with no dirty fields; wrap announcements and option labels in Lingui messages and re-extract.
